ja283:1.1: Varaṃ varaṃ tvaṃ nihanaṃ pure cari asmiṃ padese abhibhuyya sūkare, so dāni eko vyapagamma jhāyasi, balaṃ nu te vyaggha na c' ajja vijjatīti.
ja283:2.1: Ime sudaṃ yanti disodisaṃ pure bhayadditā lenagavesino puthu, te dāni saṃgamma rasanti ekato, yatthaṭṭhitā duppasah' ajja 'me mayā ti.
ja283:3.1: Nam' atthu saṃghānaṃ samāgatānaṃ, disvā sayaṃ sakhya vadāmi abbhutaṃ vyagghaṃ migā yattha jiniṃsu dāṭhino sāmaggiyā dāṭhabalesu muccare ti.
